note.zh: 审核签核文件，由审核者手工编辑。键是 review-queue.json 里的审核项 id；构建脚本（bun tools/knowledge/run.ts）只把这里签核过的条目标为 reviewed。verdict：accept＝原样通过；correct＝按 corrected 改正后通过（名称用 zh，关系用 objectLabelZh / objectLabelEn）；reject＝不成立（关系从输出中删除，名称保持未审核并留待修改）。reviewedBy 写角色，不写姓名或联系方式。
note.en: Reviewer sign-offs, edited by hand. Keys are item ids from review-queue.json; the build (bun tools/knowledge/run.ts) marks as reviewed only what is signed off here. verdict: accept = correct as it stands; correct = right once `corrected` is applied (zh for names; objectLabelZh / objectLabelEn for relations); reject = wrong (a relation is removed from the output, a name stays unreviewed for rework). reviewedBy is a role, never a name or contact detail.
